name: faq-block
title: FAQ block
description: Questions and answers as the pricing page sets them: the heading in the first of three columns, each question under a hairline in Funnel Display with its answer in DM Sans in the soft gray.
use_for: The questions section of a pricing, product or contact page.
never: Answers the product does not state
Accordions that hide a short answer
source: Built from the pricing page template's questions (hairlines on Black, Funnel Display and DM Sans per the guidelines); the answers are the plan's and the assets' own copy
